description: Create Inbox Placement Test - Test email deliverability across providers

body.description: Email body HTML (required for custom content_type)

content_type.description: Required when source is from-salesblink or mode is recurring

email_senders.description: Array of email senders and/or folders to send test emails from. Folders are expanded server-side into all senders they contain. Duplicates are automatically removed.

key.description: UUID of the folder or sender (same as value). For folders this is the folder UUID; for individual senders this is the sender UUID.

label.description: Human-readable display label, e.g. folder name or sender email address.

serviceName.description: Service type: 'folder' for folders, or any non-folder value for individual senders (commonly the provider name).

value.description: UUID of the folder or sender (same as key). The UUID used by the server to resolve the sender or folder.

plainText.description: Send as plain text instead of HTML

schedule_day.description: Day of week: 0=Sunday to 6=Saturday (required when mode is recurring)

sender_id.description: Legacy single sender UUID. Mutually exclusive with email_senders.

template_id.description: Template ObjectId (required for template content_type or sequence content_type)

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: create_inbox_placement_test

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Create Inbox Placement Test
